🎥🎬: Day Drinker

A mysterious young woman working as a bartender on a luxury yacht crosses paths with a mysterious day drinker who seems to be hiding more than he lets on. What begins as an unusual encounter quickly pulls them into a dangerous world of crime and deception.

As the pair become entangled with a powerful criminal figure, their secrets begin to surface. Forced to rely on each other, they navigate betrayals, dangerous confrontations, and a growing threat that puts both of their lives at risk.

With the yacht becoming the center of a deadly game, the unlikely duo must figure out who they can trust before their enemies catch up with them.

#DayDrinker #JohnnyDepp #PenelopeCruz #ActionThriller #MoviePlot

source_details.title: Day Drinker
source_details.synopsis: Day Drinker is an upcoming American supernatural revenge thriller film directed by Marc Webb and written by Zach Dean. It stars Johnny Depp, Madelyn Cline, and Penélope Cruz. The film is scheduled to be released in the United States on March 26, 2027.
